title: 第19章 煞海沉骨王剑残鸣第20章 恨火淬魂剑魄涅盘
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
绝对的黑暗。
绝对的死寂。
唯有精纯到近乎凝固的庚金煞气，如同粘稠冰冷的液态金属，包裹着、渗透着、侵蚀着每一寸存在。
这里是万剑冢的核心，埋葬着上古剑修锋芒与执念的终极坟场，也是孕育无尽毁灭的煞气之源。
阴九幽的“意识”
如同一粒微尘，在这片无边无际的煞气之海中沉浮。
他的躯体，早已在强行开启门户的自爆中化为齑粉，与混乱的剑气、白无尘的月华余波、以及万剑核钥破碎的能量混合在一起，形成了一团微小的、不断被庚金煞气冲刷、湮灭又重组的暗金色“尘埃”
这尘埃的核心，是那杆彻底死寂的万魂幡。
幡杆之上，属于金甲骸骨王魂的那截白骨，此刻却如同久旱逢甘霖的枯木，正贪婪地、本能地吮吸着周围无尽的庚金煞气！
丝丝缕缕闪烁着金属寒芒的精纯煞气，被白骨强行抽取、炼化，融入杆身。
原本布满蛛网裂痕的幡杆，在这至纯煞气的滋养下，竟以极其缓慢的速度弥合着裂痕，色泽变得更加暗沉内敛，隐隐透出一股沉睡的王者威严。
而包裹着万魂幡的“尘埃”
中，属于阴九幽的那部分残存意识碎片、神魂本源、以及那丝被淬炼到极致的恨火意志。
也在这被动吸收的过程中，如同被投入熔炉的矿石，经受着庚金煞气无休止的冲刷、切割、磨砺！
痛苦！
比凌迟更甚万倍的痛苦！
每一瞬都如同被亿万柄微小的飞剑穿刺神魂！
意识在崩溃的边缘无数次徘徊，又被那冰冷纯粹的恨意强行拉回。
炼气十层…炼气十一层…炼气十二层…大圆满！
被动吸收的庚金煞气太过庞大精纯，阴九幽那早已被淬炼到极限的炼气期境界壁垒，在这无休止的痛苦冲刷下，如同纸糊般被层层冲破！

他的“存在”
本质在升华，虽然肉身尽毁，但神魂本源却在煞气的磨砺下，被动地、强行地踏入了——筑基期！
但这筑基，非比寻常！
没有霞光瑞彩，没有灵气灌体，只有无尽的庚金煞气在神魂本源中凝聚、固化！
他的“道基”
，非是灵台莲座，亦非金丹雏形，而是一柄由纯粹庚金煞气和冰冷恨意凝聚而成的——暗金煞剑虚影！
悬浮在意识的核心，散发着斩灭万物、洞穿轮回的恐怖锐意！
这是煞气筑基！
是万剑冢赋予他的、独一无二的、充满毁灭性的根基！
然而，这强行突破带来的力量，如同无主之刃，狂暴而难以驾驭。
他的意识依旧混沌，如同风中残烛，随时会被这柄“煞剑道基”
的锋芒反噬撕裂，彻底湮灭。
就在这混沌与痛苦交织的沉沦中，一个声音，如同穿透无尽黑暗的温柔月光，轻轻拂过阴九幽濒临破碎的意识：
“唉…好重的煞气…好深的恨意…可怜的人儿…”
声音空灵、纯净，带着一种悲天悯人的哀伤，仿佛能抚平世间一切伤痛。
在这充满毁灭的煞海中，这声音如同天籁。
阴九幽混乱的意识微微一滞。
恨火本能地警惕，但那声音中的纯净与哀伤，却如同沙漠中的甘泉，让他饱受折磨的神魂感到一丝难以言喻的…渴望。
“你是谁…”
content_en:
Absolute darkness.
Absolute silence.
Only the Gengjin evil spirit, which is so pure that it is almost solidified, is like thick and cold liquid metal, wrapping, permeating, and eroding every inch of existence.
This is the core of the Tomb of Ten Thousand Swords, the ultimate cemetery where the edge and obsession of ancient sword cultivators are buried. It is also the source of evil energy that breeds endless destruction.
Yin Jiuyou’s “consciousness”
Like a tiny speck of dust, floating up and down in this boundless sea of evil spirits.
His body had already been turned into powder in the self-destruction of the forced opening of the portal. It was mixed with the chaotic sword energy, the aftermath of Bai Wuchen's moonlight, and the energy of the broken Wanjian core key, forming a tiny group of dark golden "dust" that was constantly being washed away, annihilated and reorganized by Gengjin evil energy.
The core of this dust is the completely dead Ten Thousand Souls Flag.
On top of the flagpole, the white bones belonging to the soul of the Golden Skeleton King are now like dead trees that have experienced a long drought, greedily and instinctively sucking in the endless Gengjin evil energy around them!
Wisps of pure evil energy shimmering with cold metallic light were forcibly extracted and refined by the bones, and integrated into the shaft.
The flagpole, which was originally covered with cobweb cracks, was nourished by this pure evil spirit, and the cracks were healed at an extremely slow speed. The color became darker and more restrained, faintly revealing the majesty of a sleeping king.
And the "dust" wrapping the Ten Thousand Souls Flag
Among them, the remaining fragments of consciousness belonging to Yin Jiuyou, the origin of the soul, and the will of hatred that have been tempered to the extreme.
Also in this passive absorption process, it is like ore being thrown into a furnace, undergoing endless erosion, cutting, and sharpening by Gengjin evil spirit!
pain!
Ten thousand times more painful than Ling Chi!
Every moment is like being pierced by billions of tiny flying swords!
His consciousness wandered on the edge of collapse countless times, only to be forcibly pulled back by the cold and pure hatred.
The tenth level of Qi refining... the eleventh level of Qi refining... the twelfth level of Qi refining... Great Perfection!
The Gengjin evil energy passively absorbed was too huge and pure. Yin Jiuyou's Qi refining stage realm barrier, which had been tempered to the limit, was broken through layer by layer like paper under the endless pain!
his "presence"
The essence is sublimating. Although the physical body is completely destroyed, the origin of the soul is tempered by the evil spirit, passively and forcefully entering the foundation building stage!
But this foundation building is extraordinary!
There is no rosy glow, no spiritual energy filling the body, only endless Gengjin evil energy condensed and solidified in the origin of the soul!
His "Taoji"
, it is not the rosette on the spiritual platform, nor the prototype of the golden elixir, but a phantom of the dark gold evil sword condensed from pure Geng metal evil energy and cold hatred!
Suspended in the core of consciousness, it exudes the terrifying sharpness to destroy all things and penetrate reincarnation!
This is evil spirit foundation building!
It was the unique and destructive foundation given to him by Wanjian Tomb!
However, the power brought by this forced breakthrough is like a masterless blade, violent and difficult to control.
His consciousness is still chaotic, like a candle in the wind, he will be struck by this "Evil Sword Daoji" at any time.
The sharp edge backfired and tore apart, completely annihilating it.
In this sinking intertwined with chaos and pain, a voice, like the gentle moonlight penetrating the endless darkness, gently brushed through Yin Jiuyou's consciousness that was on the verge of being broken:
"Sigh... Such a strong evil spirit... Such deep hatred... Poor man..."
The voice is ethereal and pure, with a kind of compassionate sadness that seems to be able to heal all the pain in the world.
In this evil sea full of destruction, this voice is like the sound of nature.
Yin Jiuyou's confused consciousness stagnated slightly.
Hatred was instinctively vigilant, but the purity and sorrow in the voice were like the sweet spring in the desert, making his tortured soul feel an indescribable... longing.
"Who are you…"
